build.qualification: Benchmark-only source snapshot adds one harness=false bench registration; production src bytes match the working tree. Clock-free accounting is separate from timing.

timing.qualification: Sequential fixed-order timing after task-owned builds/checks completed; this does not assert desktop idleness. Five samples per mode/case; Both caller destinations are allocated outside timing. Persistent dictionary preparation is excluded; per-session dictionary handle clone/drop, cold session construction, scratch allocation/drop, frame checks and decoding are timed with Global; tracking ledgers are excluded. Whole/seven-byte input schedules are fixed. Reused-session performance is not measured.

summary.aggregation: Geometric mean of per-case median latency ratios across ten nonempty workloads with equal case weights. Empty streams remain separate. Whole and seven-byte fragmented inputs are separate comparisons. Lower means lower observed latency; no confidence intervals or general speedup claim.

qualification: Fixed-order sequential measurements on this host, with task-owned compiler/test jobs completed before the recorded CPU barrier. No claim of desktop idleness, statistical significance, architecture independence or general unsafe speedup. Primary contains safe/all/20 isolated backends; independent rebuilt repeat contains safe/all. Allocation qualification is separate from timing. Every sample is retained.
